name: Splithoof Hold
summary: Galak centaur guard Splithoof Hold in the caves of Splithoof Crag. Within, the Ancient Brazier keeps their sacred flame burning without end.

sections.title: A Centaur Bastion
sections.body: Within Splithoof Crag, Galak centaur defend their cavern against rival tribes and travelers crossing Thousand Needles. Its deep shelter protects them from the windswept canyon floor. Chokepoints guard the way in, with a secure refuge inside the rock.

sections.title: The Sacred Flame
sections.body: Deep within Splithoof Hold, the Ancient Brazier cradles the Sacred Flame. The mystic fire burns without end. The centaur honor it in ritual, while spiritual wanderers from across the canyon come to wonder at its power.

faq.answer: Splithoof Hold lies within Splithoof Crag, along the northern cliffs of Thousand Needles. Enter through a cave opening in the main centaur settlement.
The Galak centaur hold Splithoof Hold and defend it fiercely against outsiders, beasts, and the nearby tauren of Freewind Post.
Beyond its hostile Galak centaur defenders, the cave holds the Ancient Brazier. Its power keeps the mystical Sacred Flame burning without end in the depths of the rock.

angles.text: As a tauren, you face sworn blood enemies in the Galak centaur. Their stronghold in Thousand Needles threatens the peace of Freewind Post.
As a shaman, you may be drawn to the eternal flame deep within the dark stone cavern. Its elemental fire remains a mystery.
